Right, listen up. If the words look like they’ve gone through a blender, it means the game’s graphics settings are probably cranked up too high, or somethin' ain't right with how the deck's handling the display. You gotta check the in-game settings first, yeah?

First thing, look for any stuff called "Text Scale," "UI Scaling," or "Font Size." If those are set way too high, the text gets stretched out and looks like a mess. Try dialin' that back down a notch.

Then, go into your Steam Deck system settings—the big menu where you change the look of the whole thing. Look for the graphics settings. You might need to try lowering the overall rendering quality or maybe switch the scaling mode. Sometimes switching from "Full Screen" to a specific aspect ratio setting can fix those weird blurriness issues.

If you’re still seeing dodgy text, you might need to tweak the GPU clock a bit to make sure it’s running smooth. But for now, just start with the in-game scaling. Keep it simple, yeah?
